subject: SPECTRE decision-analysis engine, commit ddba577829b6de0a924d76c82077931cd2ba69f8 (version 0.24.2)
rule: A level is awarded only when every element of its descriptor is evidenced; partial evidence takes the lower level.

gates.gap: no stored decision record to replay from
one rule shown; no disagreement flag; rule chosen after results
no judgement tag; lookups without source, owner or date; substantially met for the basis tag, no dated plan
none for the gate; recommendation stability is an L3 matter
P-12 passes and P-13 quantifies the RK45 error, but neither is in the repository's suite; substantially met, no dated plan
no hazard analysis or safety-related determination visible
no engine threat model or Secure by Design artefacts; UDL element sets never checksum-checked (P-14, F-25)
no stated operating design domain; deep-space and decayed objects pass silently (P-14); substantially met for detection, no dated plan

lenses.name: Decision-model soundness
lenses.justification: Level 2 met: assumptions listed (docs/decision_engine_phases.md D1 to D15, docs/threat_confidence_concept.md section 9), COA and response types documented, weights recorded without method. Level 3 not met: no vetoes (G4), rules not shown side by side (G3), weights not swing-weighted, and the closest-approach scale makes the core criterion nearly inert (F-10).

lenses.name: Input fidelity and provenance
lenses.justification: Level 2 met: provenance tags exist (computed, sampled, lookup) but are incomplete. Level 3 not met: judgement inputs untagged, SGP4 and production RK45 not verified in the repository, element-set error absent from the miss payoff. Probe P-12 shows SGP4 matches the published vectors, but from evaluation/ only; P-14 shows UDL element sets are never checksum-checked (F-25).

lenses.name: Uncertainty propagation and presentation
lenses.justification: Level 2 met: intervals shown (sampled P5 to P95, TCA uncertainty, P intervals under expected value). Level 3 not met: element-set error not propagated to payoffs, no weight stability shown though a 0.089 change in one weight flips the pick in bound scenarios.

lenses.name: V&V and test evidence
lenses.justification: Level 2 met: a large developer suite (8,351 tests passing), reference cases (tests/unit/test_decision_reference_cases.py), coverage floors and a mutation run. Level 3 not met: no metamorphic or published-vector suite in the repository and no V&V documented to the Aqua Book; the developer suite is not independent V&V.

lenses.name: Human-in-the-loop and explainability
lenses.justification: Level 1: one rule's answer is shown and no decision record is kept. Rationale text is extensive (every figure's basis, refusals in sentences), but level 2 also requires the operator's decision to be logged, and it is not.

lenses.name: Safety management
lenses.justification: Level 1: no hazard analysis visible in the repository (provisional pending any artefact held elsewhere).

lenses.name: Security
lenses.justification: Level 2 met: an application threat-model draft exists as the audit's trust-boundary inventory with validation observed, and a security audit with a remediation log. Level 3 not met: ISN 2023/09 principles not applied as such, no integrity controls for decision records (none exist), Content Security Policy allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.

lenses.name: AI governance alignment
lenses.justification: Level 1: no AI scoping decision (JSP 936 in or out of scope) is recorded in the repository.
evidence: search of docs/, audit/ and root documents for JSP 936: no match

lenses.name: Efficiency and timeliness
lenses.justification: Level 2 met: runtime measured and used to set the budget (measured rates recorded at spectre/domain/decision.py:2088-2101; wall time shown with each result). Level 3 not met: no decision window is stated, so it cannot be shown to be met.
